_comment: Values below are NOT frozen. They are configuration awaiting P1/P2 approval and registration. Nothing in contracts/schemas may default to them. Set registered=true only with a real decision_date and reference.

week_definition.note: P1 binding decision A: UTC ISO 8601 weeks for all weekly series and baselines; fixed 7-day bins not adopted.

sealed_window.note: P1 binding decision C names the sealed 2020-2021 evaluation window; UTC calendar days 2020-01-01..2021-12-31 inclusive, all sensors (plan L46; P5 d0b8c90).

sealed_partial_reason.note: Contract representation of P1 binding decision C: straddling periods use permitted days only, are partial and comparison-ineligible with null unusual and critical labels. Periods wholly inside the window are excluded (P2 r11 section 3, origin/handoff 8f67011).

week_53_minimum.note: P1 binding decision B: at least 3 complete, supported, eligible prior ISO week-53 observations per sensor and policy; never substitute weeks 52 or 1; otherwise insufficient_baseline and the unusual label is withheld (null).
week_53_minimum.agreed_rule: Three complete, supported, eligible prior ISO week-53 observations from the same sensor and policy; otherwise insufficient_baseline and no unusual label.

footprint_certification.note: P2 r9 Q3 rule (origin/handoff b18ed3e, handoff/verdicts/P4/P4-B-001/r9-P2.md section 1) represented in contract 1.4.0: complete/partial need cell_level footprint_evidence plus P2 reference and UTC timestamp; day_level or none never certify. P2 states no region-period is certified complete today (status unverified). Coverage minimum C_MIN (proposed 0.99, alternative 1.0) is NOT registered, so any processed coverage below 1.0 is flagged low_processed_coverage.

holdout_baseline_policy.note: Document date is later than its commit time; both recorded as found, neither adjusted. Pre-freeze: 2020-2021 strictly ineligible in eligible_prior_years. Post-freeze inclusion needs P5's four conditions and a separate contract revision.

current_phase_coverage.note: Data scope as stated by P2 in its r8 review; held as configuration and read by the fixture builder. Not hard-coded in the schema. The S-NPP 2026 cutoff is reserved/inactive while S-NPP coverage ends before 2026-11-02.

coverage_minimum_c_min.note: Unregistered. Until P1/P2 register it, the contract treats any processed_coverage < 1.0 as low_processed_coverage (fail closed).

mid_record_missing_files.source_ref: origin/handoff b18ed3e: r9-P2.md section 3 and required change 1
mid_record_missing_files.rule_as_written_by_p2: Sensor-period partial (missing_days_or_tiles) or unavailable (no_file); comparison_eligible false; labels suppressed; values from missing days null, never zero.
mid_record_missing_files.note: P2 proposes label suppression and states the final display rule is P4/P1. Contract 1.4.0 suppresses labels (fail closed). P1 confirmation pending.

baseline_year_validity.p2_proposal: A year enters a baseline only if >= 9 of 12 months are kept AND the O floor is met, per sensor; if a required year is invalid the baseline is unavailable (required_year_invalid), never shortened, no replacement year.
baseline_year_validity.note: Representation (excluded_years, required_year_invalid, unavailable) is in contract 1.4.0. The validity threshold is a P1 decision and unregistered: until then any eligible prior year must have a file for every day.

paired_comparison_scope.rule: Only paired MODIS/VIIRS comparisons require both sensors complete; Aqua-only and cross-era comparisons judge each sensor on its own state.
paired_comparison_scope.note: Matches paired_comparison_eligible as implemented since 1.3.0. P1 has not separately confirmed.

week_53_critical_ranking.note: P1 decision record lists week-53 critical ranking as OPEN: week 53 is unranked; contract requires critical_status null on every week-53 record.
